model: claude-in-session (Sonnet 5) — reclassification after adding part_of/symbol_of to the verb vocabulary (DESIGN.md #5)
note: These 6 pairs were judged 'associated' in the original Phase 5 batch specifically because the fixed vocabulary had no honest slot for the relationship the evidence actually showed. No new evidence was consulted — same citations as the original pass, now expressible with the extended vocabulary.

judgments.justification: Linen is one material dress was made from (2 Sam 6:14's linen ephod) — now expressible as part_of rather than forced into associated.
Exod 29:40/Num 15:7 confirm wine as the drink-offering's material component.
Easton's own Lamp entry calls it 'that part of the candle-sticks... which bore the light' — an explicit part-whole relation.
Exod 39:28/Ezek 44:18 explicitly name linen as the head-dress's material.
Exod 16:10 and Easton's own Shechinah entry ('he went before them in a pillar of a cloud... the symbol of his presence') establish the cloud as the visible form the Shechinah took.
1 Kings 18:38/Lev 9:24 show fire, like the cloud, as a visible form the divine presence (Shechinah) took.
